title: Architecture Decision Management Capability
summary: The ability to take, record, govern and trace architecture decisions consistently across teams.
body_markdown:
# Architecture Decision Management Capability

## Description

Taking decisions with explicit criteria and options, recording them, approving them with the right decision rights, and tracing them to implementation.

## Outcomes

Fewer re-debated decisions; auditable architecture; faster onboarding.

## Enablers

[[Architecture Decision Framework]], [[Decision Rights Model]], decision trees and scoring models.

## Maturity Indicators

| Level | Indicator |
|---|---|
| 1 Fragmented | Decisions in meeting notes and e-mail |
| 2 Documented | ADRs written for some decisions |
| 3 Structured | ADRs linked to principles, patterns and architectures |
| 4 Governed | Approval per decision rights, recorded and auditable |
| 5 Executable | Decision logic and rules executed by tools; decisions validated against implementations |
